# Remediation and automation: permissions

Remediation campaigns, suppression and exception rules, assignment rules and automation workflows.

- **CTEM stages:** mobilization
- **Modules:** `remediation`, `suppressions`, `workflows` (the routes answer `403 MODULE_NOT_ENABLED` when the module is off)
- **Permissions:** `automations:publish`, `automations:read`, `automations:write`, `findings:assign`, `findings:fix_apply`, `findings:read`, `findings:remediation:read`, `findings:remediation:write`, `findings:suppressions:approve`, `findings:suppressions:delete`, `findings:suppressions:read`, `findings:suppressions:write`, `findings:write`, `team:assignment_rules:delete`, `team:assignment_rules:read`, `team:assignment_rules:write`

## Who can do it

Built-in roles and role templates whose permissions pass each route. Owner and administrator are included where the route allows them.

| Permission | Roles |
|---|---|
| `automations:publish` | Owner, Administrator |
| `automations:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager |
| `automations:write` | Owner, Administrator, Vulnerability manager |
| `findings:assign` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, AppSec engineer, Bug-bounty triager |
| `findings:fix_apply` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Remediation owner |
| `findings:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, CI integrator, Scan operator, Validation engineer, Researcher, Bug-bounty triager, Threat intelligence analyst, Risk approver, Auditor, Executive viewer |
| `findings:remediation:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, Scan operator, Validation engineer, Bug-bounty triager, Threat intelligence analyst, Risk approver, Auditor, Executive viewer |
| `findings:remediation:write` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Vulnerability manager |
| `findings:suppressions:approve` | Owner, Administrator, CTEM program lead, Risk approver |
| `findings:suppressions:delete` | Owner, Administrator |
| `findings:suppressions:read` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, AppSec engineer, Bug-bounty triager, Risk approver, Auditor |
| `findings:suppressions:write` | Owner, Administrator, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, AppSec engineer |
| `findings:write` | Owner, Administrator, Member, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, Validation engineer, Researcher, Bug-bounty triager, Threat intelligence analyst |
| `team:assignment_rules:delete` | Owner, Administrator |
| `team:assignment_rules:read` | Owner, Administrator, Vulnerability manager |
| `team:assignment_rules:write` | Owner, Administrator, Vulnerability manager |
